_comment: Default commits resolved when no explicit branch/hash is supplied. Update these after verifying a build passes with a newer commit.

_provenance.susfs_android15-6.6: simonpunk/susfs4ksu branch gki-android15-6.6 -> f98f0822 (2026-11-15, 'kernel & KernelSU: Sync with upstream'), SUSFS_VERSION 'v2.4.0' read from kernel_patches/include/linux/susfs.h at that ref.
_provenance.ksu_main: tiann/KernelSU main HEAD 64833c00 (2026-11, 'feat(kernel): Add LSM hook for inode_setxattr (#3996)'). SUSFS v2.4.0's commit message names this exact SHA as its KernelSU sync point, so the two are matched by construction.
_provenance.ksun_dev: KernelSU-Next dev HEAD 7ccf6147, which carries the same inode_setxattr LSM hook (#3996) that SUSFS v2.4.0's KernelSU half expects.
_provenance.why_paired: The susfs pins are keyed per KSU variant because each flavour tracks the susfs sync at a different point. A SUSFS revision and a KernelSU revision must agree on the selinux_hide dispatch shape: v2.4.0 added susfs_selinux_inode_setxattr/_post_setxattr handlers that the KernelSU side must provide. Pairing v2.4.0 with a pre-64833c00 KernelSU drops that half of the feature.
_provenance.history: Previously pinned android15-6.6 KSU=937215c / KSUN=be7b7ef, both at SUSFS v2.2.0-v2.3.0. The v2.3.0 branch of the action used to hard-fail for KSUN on the belief that WildKernels' fix sets stopped at v2.2.0; next/susfs_fix_patches/v2.3.0/ and v2.4.0/ both exist upstream and ship the same fix_<file>.patch set, so that gate has been removed.
